theme: 3 SwiftUI terms for multi-column apps on iPad and Mac

terms.definition: A column on the side that lists places or items to choose from.
terms.example: Show the folders in the Sidebar.

terms.definition: A view that shows two or three columns and updates the detail when you pick an item.
terms.example: Use a NavigationSplitView for the mail app on iPad.

terms.definition: A side panel that shows details about the selected item.
terms.example: Open an Inspector to show the photo size.

video.title: Sidebar, NavigationSplitView & Inspector | Day 174
video.description:
Learn to explain how SwiftUI builds multi-column screens for iPad and Mac: Sidebar, NavigationSplitView & Inspector, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Sidebar - A column on the side that lists places or items to choose from.
NavigationSplitView - A view that shows two or three columns and updates the detail when you pick an item.
Inspector - A side panel that shows details about the selected item.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 174 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

#Shorts #iOSDev #Swift #LearnEnglish

landscape.title: SwiftUI Sidebar, NavigationSplitView & Inspector | Day 174
landscape.description:
Explain Sidebar, NavigationSplitView & Inspector in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
사이드바, 내비게이션스플릿뷰, 인스펙터 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Sidebar - A column on the side that lists places or items to choose from.
한국어: 사이드바: 선택할 장소나 항목을 나열하는 옆쪽 열

NavigationSplitView - A view that shows two or three columns and updates the detail when you pick an item.
한국어: 내비게이션스플릿뷰: 두 개 또는 세 개의 열을 보여 주고 항목을 고르면 상세를 바꾸는 뷰

Inspector - A side panel that shows details about the selected item.
한국어: 인스펙터: 선택한 항목의 자세한 정보를 보여 주는 옆 패널

landscape.hook: Can you explain Sidebar, NavigationSplitView and Inspector in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the mail app looks too big for one column on iPad.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a NavigationSplitView. It gives you a Sidebar and a detail view.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The folders, like Inbox. In the code, the Sidebar is the first closure.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is the `detail`. It changes when the user picks a folder.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I used a NavigationStack on iPad before, and it looked stretched.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, a NavigationSplitView fits wide screens much better.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What if I want to show the message size and date?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add an Inspector. It opens on the side with extra details.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can the Inspector stay open next to the message?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: On a wide screen, yes. On iPhone it becomes a sheet.
